
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19234843" title="发布于 2025-11-17 23:40">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Tauri2.9+Vue3电脑端OS系统|vite7+tauri2+arcoDesign桌面os后台模板</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(102, 102, 255, 1)">最新版<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">tauri2.9+vite7.2+pinia3+arco</span>仿macOS/wins管理系统<em>TauriVue3OS</em>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>vite7-tauri2-os</strong>基于最新跨平台框架<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">tauri2.9+vite7.2.2+vue3 setup+pinia3+arco-design+echarts</span>实战桌面客户端OS管理后台模板。内置<strong>macOS+windows</strong>两种桌面模板、<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 255, 1)">可拖拽栅格菜单、支持JSON格式配置桌面菜单/Dock菜单</span>。</span></p>
<p><img alt="002360截图20251116225622766" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117215101215-2016109363.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251116223719590" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117215202812-1484546453.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>技术栈</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：VScode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">跨平台技术：tauri^2.9</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">前端框架技术：vite^7.2.2+vue^3.5.24+vue-router^4.6.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">组件库：@arco-design/web-vue^2.57.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.4</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">拖拽插件：sortablejs^1.15.6</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">滑屏插件：swiper^12.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">图表组件：echarts^6.0.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">markdown编辑器：md-editor-v3^6.1.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">模拟数据：mockjs^1.1.0</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="a2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117215505444-1607964411.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="a6" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117215826619-2104478883.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目特征</h3>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">基于最新技术栈Tauri2.9、Vite7.2、Vue3 setup、Pinia3、ArcoDesign、Echarts</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2.x封装新开多窗口管理</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">提供macOS+windows两种风格桌面模板</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持json格式配置桌面菜单+Dock菜单</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">自研可拖拽桌面栅格卡片布局</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持自定义桌面背景皮肤、采用高斯模糊毛玻璃效果</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">提供图表、表格、列表、表单、编辑器等常用页面模板</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">支持主窗口或独立新窗口打开路由页面</span></li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="a3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117215947886-1119271893.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目框架结构</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">tauri2-vite7-os 使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vite7.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span></span>&nbsp;整合&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">tauri2.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span></span>&nbsp;跨平台框架搭建项目，采用<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 204, 255, 1)">vue3 setup</span>语法开发页面。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20251116213614040" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117221819226-382023817.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>入口配置main.js</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 渲染进程配置main.js
 * @author andy
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { createApp } from </span>'vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import </span>'./style.scss'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import App from </span>'./App.vue'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入插件配置</span>
import Plugins from './plugins'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入路由/状态配置</span>
import Router from './router'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import Pinia from </span>'./pinia'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

createApp(App)
.use(Router)
.use(Pinia)
.use(Plugins)
.mount(</span>"#app")</pre>
</div>

<h3>tauri2-vue3os桌面模板</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">提供了macOS和windows两种布局模板。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117223242638-521043888.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import { appState } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/pinia/modules/app</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>

  <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引入布局模板</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  import MacosLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/macos.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  import WindowsLayout from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">./template/windows.vue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  const appstate </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> appState()

  const DeskLayout </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    macos: MacosLayout,
    windows: WindowsLayout
  }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__container flexbox"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{'--themeSkin': appstate.config.skin}"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">component </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="DeskLayout[appstate.config.layout]"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="vu__layout-header"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<h3>tauri2-vue3os桌面栅格结构</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117232120364-93272066.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117232146127-2054207888.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117232237814-578293154.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>自定义桌面菜单图标变量</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const deskVariable =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref({
    </span>'--icon-radius': '10px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 圆角</span>
    '--icon-size': '60px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标尺寸</span>
    '--icon-gap-col': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 水平间距</span>
    '--icon-gap-row': '30px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 垂直间距</span>
    '--icon-labelSize': '12px', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签文字大小</span>
    '--icon-labelColor': '#fff', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标签颜色</span>
    '--icon-fit': 'contain', <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图标自适应模式</span>
})</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>桌面菜单配置参数</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * @name Desk桌面菜单配置参数
 * @param label 图标标题
 * @param imgico 图标(本地或网络图片) 支持Arco-Design内置图标或自定义iconfont图标
 * @param path 跳转路由页面
 * @param link 跳转外部链接
 * @param hideLabel 是否隐藏图标标题
 * @param filter 是否禁用拖拽
 * @param background 自定义图标背景色
 * @param color 自定义图标颜色
 * @param size 栅格磁贴布局 1x1 ... 12x12
 * @param padding 内边距
 * @param onClick 点击图标回调函数
 * @param isNewin 新窗口打开路由页面
 * @param children 二级菜单
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117232553443-1881077283.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202511/1289798-20251117232624725-1166125071.png" class="lazyload"></p>
